architecture.mechanism: Pooling many smaller units integrates their individual contributions so the aggregate delivers greater sustained capability than any single unit can provide on its own — the paper integrates smaller studies to achieve statistical power beyond any single study.
architecture.intervention: Rebuild the drill battery as a parallel-multiplied modular bank: many smaller high-discharge cells in parallel with active per-cell balancing and a current-sharing bus, so heavy-load current is drawn from all cells simultaneously instead of stressing a single series string; add a short-duration buffer (supercapacitor) to absorb inrush during load transitions.
architecture.expected_effect: Per-cell current and heat fall in proportion to the number of paralleled cells, reducing voltage sag and internal-resistance-driven capacity loss under heavy load; the pack holds near-full voltage through a full construction shift, extending runtime toward the no-swap target.
architecture.falsification_test: Build two packs of equal nominal capacity and volume — (A) a single high-capacity series string, (B) the parallel-multiplied balanced bank — and run a standardized heavy-load duty cycle (repeated high-torque drilling with logged current) to cutoff voltage; if B does not deliver at least 20% more usable capacity with lower per-cell temperature rise than A, the mechanism is falsified.
